0022600119.text: The Wizards (2-1, 1-0 on the road, 3rd in the Southeast and 6th in the East) visit the Hornets (2-1, 1-1 at home, 2nd in the Southeast and 7th in the East) for Washington's fourth game of the season. Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve), while Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Wizards lost all four matchups in 2025-26, most recently 129-112 in Washington on February 22, 2026.
